_comment: Hindi words the crop LLM sometimes writes even when asked for Marathi (language=mr), paired with the correct Marathi word. Applied by main.py's _apply_mr_word_fixes to LLM-sourced reason/risk text, mr only. Whole-word replacement only (matched as a standalone, space-separated token with leading/trailing punctuation ignored) -- never a substring inside a longer word. Not yet checked by a native speaker or the local KVK -- reviewed:false, same convention as crop_messages.json and disease_names.json.
